guarantees.claim: On asynchronous negedge of rst_ni, status_alert_fatal_fault is cleared to 1'b0.
On posedge clk_i when rst_ni is high and alert_fatal is high, status_alert_fatal_fault is set to 1'b1.
When rst_ni is high and alert_fatal is low, status_alert_fatal_fault retains its previous value (sticky behavior).

assumptions.claim: alert_fatal must be stable and meet setup/hold around posedge clk_i and remain high for at least one full clk_i cycle to be captured.
assumptions.risk: A pulse shorter than one cycle or violating timing may be missed, leaving the fault unrecorded.

uncertain_points.claim: status_alert_fatal_fault is only cleared on hardware reset; there is no in-module clear mechanism. The ability to clear this sticky bit (e.g., via software) is unknown.
uncertain_points.cond: after a fault has been serviced
uncertain_points.risk: If the bit cannot be cleared without a full reset, any fatal alert forces a system reset, reducing availability and complicating error handling.

uncertain_points.claim: If alert_fatal is asserted while rst_ni is low, the register is held in reset and the alert will not be captured.
uncertain_points.risk: A fatal fault occurring during module reset may be permanently lost, violating safety/alert integrity expectations.
